description: This file contains API utility functions to interact with a queries backend service, handling operations like saving, listing, retrieving, deleting, and updating query records, with mock mode support for local storage.

methods.name: saveQuery({ name, protocol, deviceId, parameters, isFavorite = false })
methods.description: Saves a query for reuse, either in mock mode (local storage) or via API.

methods.name: listQueries({ page = 1, pageSize = 10, favorites = false } = {})
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of saved queries, with support for filtering favorites, mock mode fallback.

methods.name: getQueryById(queryId)
methods.description: Fetches details of a specific query by ID, using mock data or API.

methods.name: deleteQuery(queryId)
methods.description: Deletes a query by ID, either in mock mode (local storage) or via API.

methods.name: toggleFavorite(queryId, isFavorite)
methods.description: Toggles the favorite status of a query.

methods.name: getQueryHistory({ page = 1, pageSize = 10, protocol, deviceId, status, search, dateFrom, dateTo, sort } = {})
methods.description: Retrieves query execution history with advanced filtering options, supporting mock mode fallback.

methods.name: rerunQuery(queryId)
methods.description: Re-executes a previous query by ID.

methods.name: addLocalQueryRecord(record)
methods.description: Adds a query record to local storage, maintaining schema consistency.

ctags.name: getQueryHistory
ctags.signature: ({ page = 1, pageSize = 10, protocol, deviceId, status, search, dateFrom, dateTo, sort } = {})

ctags.name: listQueries
ctags.pattern: /^export async function listQueries({ page = 1, pageSize = 10, favorites = false } = {}) {$/

ctags.pattern: /^export async function saveQuery({ name, protocol, deviceId, parameters, isFavorite = false }) {$/
ctags.signature: ({ name, protocol, deviceId, parameters, isFavorite = false })
